page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Arabic lines printed across the full width at the top and in the middle. No marginal notes. The Latin runs from top to bottom, with a short Latin line beside the Arabic block. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: رأس الملك وعلى بابه ولا يقرّون [?] حتى تخلص من اعاديهم [?]

p.i: Dixit quoque Basilius: indica mihi de Chri-stianis, qui demigrarunt ex hoc mundo peccatis coinquinati, quorumque animae inclusae sunt in locis tenebrosis, prodest ne illis Sacrificium, quod statis temporibus offertur? & utrum anima id percipiat? Respondit illi Gregorius: si B. Moyses Sacrificium operatus est, Deumque rogauit, ut condonaret Rubeno filio Iacobi peccatum illius, cuius anima cum animabus peccatorum erat, quam propterea restituit Deus ad fratres suos; quanto magis Sacerdos, cui data est potestas ligandi peccata, & soluendi? Horum autem comparatio est instar eorum hominum, qui in carcere detinentur, habentque amicos de ipsis sollicitos, qui omni tempore rogant pro eis iudicem, praesidem, & ad regis caput adstantes, & ad ianuam illius, nec desistunt, donec liberentur amici eorum. Et paulo inferius haec subdit:

main_text.p: وايضا فلو لم يسّوا براحة تنال اليهم من جهة القرابين والطلبات عنهم لما امرنا [?] به وخصّ فاعلوه بمجاهدة [?]

page.notes: Arabic lines at the top and middle are transcribed with [?] where the letters or diacritics are not clearly legible in the scan. The Arabic block in the middle sits beside the Latin line "paulo inferius haec subdit:", whose order on the page is kept as printed. The last Latin line ends with the catchword "ex", which is given only in bottom_margin. The page has no running head and no visible signature.
